import os
	
	def list_files(directory):
	    try:
	        # Get a list of all files in the directory
	        files = os.listdir(directory)
	        # Filter out directories from the list
	        files = [file for file in files if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(directory, file))]
	        return files
	    except OSError as e:
	        print("Error listing files: {}".format(e))
	        return []
	
	def createTreeItem(filename, directory=None):
		return {
		  "label": filename,
		  "expanded": True,
		  "data": {'filename': filename, 'directory':directory},
		  "items": []
		}
	
	def createDirItem(directory,parentPath):
		listed_files=list_files('{}/{}'.format(parentPath,directory))
		items=[]
		for filename in listed_files:
			items.append(createTreeItem(filename,directory))
		return {
			  "label": directory,
			  "expanded": True,
			  "data": {'directory':directory},
			  "icon": {"path": "material/folder_open","color": "","style": {}},
			  "items": items
			}
	
	fileStructure=[]
	parentPath=value['parent']

	
	directories=value['directories']
	for directory in directories:
		fileStructure.append(createDirItem(directory,parentPath))
	parentFiles=list_files(parentPath)	
	
	for filename in parentFiles:
		fileStructure.append(createTreeItem(filename))
	
	return fileStructure

folder=self.parent.custom.folderName
	parentPath=self.view.custom.fileSystem.path
	directory_path='{}/{}'.format(parentPath,folder)
	exchange.architecturebuilder.files.create_folder(directory_path)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.fileSystem.directories")
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selectionData=[]
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selection=[]
	self.getSibling("TextField").props.text=''
	message='New Folder "{}" Created Successfully'.format(folder)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("Toast", {"message": message, "delay": 5, "color": "--success", "textColor": "Black"}, scope="session")

import os
	
	# Specify the path to the source file and the destination folder
	src_file_path = self.view.custom.loadPath
	parentPath=self.view.custom.fileSystem.path
	dest_folder_path = self.view.custom.fileSystem.path+self.getSibling("Dropdown").props.value
	dest_file_path = os.path.join(dest_folder_path, os.path.basename(src_file_path))
		
	# Move the file
	exchange.architecturebuilder.files.move_file(src_file_path, dest_file_path)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.fileSystem.directories")
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selectionData=[]
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selection=[]
	self.getSibling("Dropdown").props.value=''
	filename=src_file_path.split('/')[-1]
	srcFolder=src_file_path.replace(parentPath,'').replace("/"+filename,'')
	desFolder=dest_file_path.replace(parentPath,'').replace("/"+filename,'')
	srcFolder = "/" if srcFolder == "" else srcFolder
	desFolder = "/" if desFolder == "" else desFolder	
	message='"{}" Successfully Moved From "{}" To "{}"'.format(filename, srcFolder, desFolder)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("Toast", {"message": message, "delay": 5, "color": "--success"}, scope="session")

import os
	
	fileType=self.view.custom.type
	parentPath=self.view.custom.fileSystem.path
	# Specify the path to the old directory and the new directory name
	if fileType=='dir':
		old_directory_path = self.view.custom.loadPath
		new_directory_path = '{}/{}'.format(parentPath,self.getSibling("TextField").props.text)
		# Rename the directory
		exchange.architecturebuilder.files.rename_directory(old_directory_path, new_directory_path)
	if fileType=='file':
		old_directory_path = self.view.custom.loadPath
		oldFilename=old_directory_path.split('/')[-1]
		newFilename=self.getSibling("TextField").props.text.replace('.json','') + '.json'
		new_directory_path = old_directory_path.replace(oldFilename,newFilename)
		exchange.architecturebuilder.files.rename_directory(old_directory_path, new_directory_path)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.fileSystem.directories")
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selectionData=[]
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selection=[]
	self.getSibling("TextField").props.text=''
	
	message='"{}" Successfully Renamed To "{}"'.format(oldFilename, newFilename)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("Toast", {"message": message, "delay": 3, "color": "--success"}, scope="session")

# Specify the path to the file you want to delete
	file_path_to_delete = self.view.custom.loadPath
	if self.view.custom.type=='file':
	# Delete the file
		exchange.architecturebuilder.files.delete_file(file_path_to_delete)
	elif self.view.custom.type=='dir':
		exchange.architecturebuilder.files.delete_directory(file_path_to_delete)
	self.getSibling("Tree").refreshBinding("props.items")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.fileSystem.directories")
	self.view.custom.loadPath=''
	self.view.custom.type=''
	self.getSibling("Tree").props.selectionData=[]
	self.getSibling("Tree").props.selection=[]
	self.props.value=0
	message='"{}" Deleted Successfully'.format(file_path_to_delete)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("Toast", {"message": message, "delay": 3, "color": "--success", "textColor": "Black"}, scope="session")
